title: Global Microsoft outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot for a second day
caption:
A Microsoft outage that began on Thursday disrupted Outlook, Teams and Copilot for businesses and governments worldwide, with about 130,000 Outlook problem reports on Downdetector at its peak. Microsoft says it has no indication of malicious activity and has not yet named a cause. On Friday it reported encouraging recovery progress, though some users still faced delayed emails.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
